ENGLISH MARCH — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. going
   D. went

   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Extensive Listening ● listening for enjoyment and g.

   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
